card.name: Second digit of durations like 25 or 40
card.fires_on: The second digit (mostly 5 or 0) of a two-digit number such as 25, 20 or 40 that is followed by a time unit like days, weeks, minutes or years. It appears in duration or interval phrases.

modes.label: Digit 5 in 25
modes.description: The 5 in 25 starting a time range or interval, often before 'to' and a larger number.
modes.example: will develop colon cancer within 2<<5>> to 35 years.

modes.label: Digit 0 in 20 or 40
modes.description: The 0 in 20 or 40 giving a length of time in weeks, seconds or months.
modes.example: must be closely monitored for at least 2<<0>> weeks for signs

card.writes: It seems to push toward number continuations and away from Chinese words for time periods like 期限 and 三个月.
card.plain: It lights up on the last digit of a number such as 25 or 40 when it measures a length of time.
